description: This file implements the core functions for a TLS (Transport Layer Security) Session Manager object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It manages timers, session sessions, and interface interactions relevant to TLS session management within a larger software system.

classes.name: TLS_SESSION_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main structure representing the TLS Session Manager, containing properties, function pointers, timers, and session management data.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE TlsSmoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new TLS Session Manager object, setting up function pointers and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the TLS Session Manager object, freeing timers, memory, and resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls necessary subordinate objects such as timers, clients, and interfaces required for TLS session management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsSmoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Session Manager object's internal state and default properties.
